metadata.description: Phase 5 (Community): visual mode editor, mode registry with signing and a verified badge, carrier PCB, translations, build guides, community processes. Refreshed 2026-10-22 after phases 2-4 software (decisions P5R-1 to P5R-14); plan phases 1 (the visual mode editor) and 2 (the editor and the simulator: field.lua shown in the web view, POST /api/reload, the editor's Test button, decisions P5B-1 to P5B-7) built in software; plan phase 13 (missing modes sent to boxes from the GM console, the maintainer's P5R-8; P5B-8 to P5B-17) planned.
